name: linux-defect-unicode-body-posts
description: The sanctioned defect sink (REST POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments) must accept a non-ASCII, multi-line defect body and echo the returned html_url — complementing WIN's ASCII defect case by proving the issue-comment REST path is UTF-8 clean end to end. Mock accepts the POST for lbabus-ci/fixture-defect issue #7 and returns { html_url } -> exit 0 with the confirmation line.
args:
Line one → arrow.
Line two accent café.
Line three CJK 日本語 tail-preserved.
